PROJECT demo-project
NAME "Demo Living Project"
PROFILE generic
MANAGER_INTENT "Continuously improve the validated twin."
SOURCE manager "data/manager" subactor://project/demo/manager authority
SOURCE customer "data/customer" subactor://project/demo/customer requirements
SOURCE development "code" subactor://project/demo/development code
SOURCE runtime "logs" subactor://project/demo/runtime runtime-log
DEVELOPMENT_ROOT "code"
DEVELOPMENT_FIXTURE "config/development.intent.fixture.json"
OBSERVATION_PATHS ["logs"]
OBSERVATION_ROOT subactor://project/demo/runtime
POLICY_APPROVED true
POLICY_REQUIRE_RESEARCH true
POLICY_REQUIRE_DEVELOPMENT true
POLICY_REQUIRE_RUNTIME true
POLICY_AUTO_PUBLISH_SCENE true
POLICY_ALLOW_RUNTIME_SELF_MODIFICATION false
POLICY_MAX_ITERATIONS_PER_HOUR 12
SCENE_FORMAT openusd
